Among the deities enshrined, five of them, including Okami no Kami, are said to have been enshrined together in later generations.

There are many examples of Shikinai-sha shrines in Ou being built by subsuming the landowner deity and inviting a central deity, but it is not clear whether this is the case for our company, and the origin of the divine name ``Shiga Riwaki'' is also uncertain {{Sfn|Shiga Riwake Shrine (Gods)|1984}}.

== Precincts ==
The approach is lined with about 30 {{ill|Cherry blossom|ace|Sakura|ar|ساكورا|az|Sakura|azb|ساکورا|bcl|Seresa|bn|চেরি ব্লসম|ca|Sakura|ckb|ساکورا|cv|Сакура|de|Japanische Kirschblüte|dtp|Sakura|el|Σάκουρα|eo|Sakuro|es|Sakura (cerezo)|eu|Sakura|fa|ساکورا|fr|Sakura|gl|Sakura (árbore)|hi|चेरी ब्लॉसम|hr|Trešnjin cvijet|hu|Cseresznyevirág|hy|Սակուրա|id|Sakura|is|Kirsuberjablóm|it|Fiore di ciliegio|ja|サクラ|jv|Sakura|ka|საკურა|kn|ಸಕುರಾ|ko|벚꽃|ks|پرَٛبٕدٔر پھٕلَے|lt|Sakura|min|Sakura|ml|ചെറി ബ്ലോസം|mn|Сакура|ms|Sakura|my|ချယ်ရီပန်း|mzn|ساکورا|nl|Sakura (bloesem)|pa|ਚੈਰੀ ਦਾ ਫੁੱਲ|pl|Sakura|pnb|چیری|ppl|Ne Sakura|pt|Sakura (cerejeira)|pwn|sakudra|ro|Sakura|ru|Сакура|sah|Сакура|sh|Trešnjin cvijet|simple|Cherry blossom|sk|Sakura (Japonsko)|sr|Трешњин цвет|sv|Sakura|th|ซากูระ|tl|Seresang namumulaklak|tr|Kiraz çiçeği|tt|Сакура|ug|نورۇزگۈلى|uk|Слива пильчаста|uz|Gilos gullari|vi|Hoa anh đào|war|Sakura (seresas)|zh|樱花|zh_min_nan|Sa-khú-lah|zh_yue|櫻花|qid=Q871991}} tall trees. The variety is {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Azumahigan}}. The largest of these trees is 6 meters and 80 centimeters in circumference at the base, 11 meters and 5 centimeters in height, and is estimated to be about 500 years old. It is believed to be the oldest group of Higanzakura in the prefecture, and has been designated as a natural monument by Shiwa Town as the ``southern cherry tree.''

== Setsusha ==
There are three shrines within the precincts as follows. </ref>.
* Sakashita Inari Shrine
* Onofuji Inari Shrine
* Akaishi Tenmangu Shrine

== Festival ==
* Donto Festival (January 15th)<ref>The description of the festival is based on the shrine history book. </ref>
*Setsubun Festival (February 3rd)
* Prayer Festival (Spring Festival) (April 29th)
* Summer Purification Ceremony (June 30th)
* Doll Festival (June 30th)
* Reitaisai (Autumn Festival) (first Friday, Saturday and Sunday of September)

== Cultural assets ==

== Shiwa Town Designated Natural Monument ==
* Cherry blossoms and Higanzakura group on the south side - Designated on March 25, 1975.
